qa_flags.issue: 53-week current TTM versus 52 prior. Q1FY2027 14 weeks. Management extra-week estimates rounded; no exact GAAP/CFO equal-week series.
qa_flags.treatment: Load reported actuals. Use separate labeled revenue sensitivity only.

qa_flags.issue: Issuer non-GAAP excludes recurring SBC and recurring restructuring.
qa_flags.treatment: Core stays GAAP; FCF after SBC is separate economic cash proxy. No automatic non-GAAP substitution.

qa_flags.issue: Internal-use software and cloud capex additions not separately disclosed.
qa_flags.treatment: Retain full PP&E capex; no invented zero, no second software capex deduction.

qa_flags.issue: DataPelago $106m contingent consideration is accrued, unpaid and outside $78m net cash purchase. Subsequent JetStream not captured in July balance.
qa_flags.treatment: Separate acquisition obligation; not ordinary working capital. No November cash certification.

qa_flags.issue: Quarter/annual EPS and shares direct, but TTM weighted shares built from rounded quarterly data and EPS is sum of quarters.
qa_flags.treatment: TTM figures labeled derived; never infer direct Q4 share count or use annual EPS subtraction.

qa_flags.issue: FY2025 14.2% tax rate affected by discrete tax items; final transition-tax payment in Q2FY2026.
qa_flags.treatment: No low historical tax extrapolation; retain cash payment in base. Show $179m timing sensitivity separately.

qa_flags.issue: Companyfacts mislabels a $287m nine-month cash-tax figure as H1FY2025.
qa_flags.treatment: Direct filing tables confirm H1 $222m and 9M $287m. Conflict preserved in inputs.

qa_flags.issue: Spot sold March2025; FY2024/25 segment comparison includes disposed operations. No full comparable organic historical series.
qa_flags.treatment: Reported financial history loadable; do not call organic/recast.
